医学影像与生物医学 AI 架构图谱 · 2012–2026An interactive compendium · 137 architectures · 2012–2026

系统梳理从局部卷积、残差跳连、全局自注意力与选择性状态空间（Mamba），到自监督表征、可提示分割、医学视觉语言模型、物理约束逆问题展开、可微配准与生理时序基础模型的技术源流。逐项还原 137 个模型的原论文结构图、前向计算节点、核心数学形式化、上一代瓶颈与临床转化证据边界。

A systematic architectural treatise tracing the evolution from local convolutions, residual highways, global self-attention, and selective state spaces (Mamba) to self-supervised pretraining, promptable segmentation, clinical vision–language models, unrolled physics-informed reconstruction, diffeomorphic registration, and physiological waveform foundation models—reconstructing all 137 primary paper diagrams, forward computation graphs, vector mathematical formalisms, and clinical evidence boundaries.

SECTION 01 // EXECUTIVE SYNTHESIS
ZH // 中文原著论述

摘要

卷积、attention 与 selective state-space model 分别提供局部空间先验、输入相关的全局交互和长序列状态压缩。医学 AI 的可靠性还取决于监督信号、任务接口、forward model、数据单位和外部验证，不能只由 backbone 名称或参数量判断。

  • 表示与计算： 局部共享卷积适合有限标注和连续解剖；self-attention 直接建立全局 token 关系，但 3D 成本通常近似随 token 数二次增长；Swin 与 Mamba 用窗口层级和状态扫描控制复杂度，同时引入 window、patch 与 scan 方向偏置。
  • 监督与复用： 对比学习、遮挡重建、自蒸馏和影像–报告对齐把复用单位从单任务权重扩展为通用 encoder；objective、患者级去重、数据单位和域外校准决定迁移是否成立。
  • 可信约束： 重建、配准、导航和 2D→3D 必须满足测量、几何、定量与病灶级约束；视觉真实感和低 measurement residual 都不能单独排除 null-space 错误。
EN // ENGLISH MONOGRAPH TEXT

Abstract

Convolutions, self-attention, and selective state-space models (SSMs) respectively encode local spatial priors, input-dependent global interactions, and long-horizon state compression. Yet clinical reliability in biomedical AI is equally governed by supervision signals, task interfaces, physical forward models, independent sampling units, and external multi-center validation—never by backbone nomenclature or parameter count alone.

  • Representation & Computation: Locally shared convolutions align naturally with scarce annotations and continuous anatomy; self-attention establishes direct all-pair token interactions in a single layer, but 3D compute and memory scale quadratically with token count O(N²); Swin and Mamba bound complexity via hierarchical windows and selective state scans, trading quadratic cost for windowing, patchification, and scan-direction inductive biases.
  • Supervision & Transferability: Contrastive learning, masked autoencoding, self-distillation, and radiology report alignment expand the unit of reuse from single-task weights to general-purpose foundation encoders; whether transfer succeeds depends on pretraining objectives, patient-level deduplication, sampling units, and out-of-domain calibration.
  • Physics & Trustworthy Constraints: Tomographic reconstruction, deformable registration, surgical navigation, and 2D-to-3D lifting must satisfy measurement consistency, geometric projection, quantitative calibration, and lesion-level fidelity; neither photorealistic texture nor low measurement residual alone can rule out null-space hallucinations.
SECTION 02 // RESEARCHER COMPETENCY TAXONOMY (47 NODES)

研究者学习树节点分布（按掌握层级） Researcher Competency Taxonomy Across 47 Core Architectural Nodes

主报告将全部核心机制与代表架构归纳为 47 个学习树节点：19 个「必须精通」节点覆盖卷积、残差、U-Net/nnU-Net、注意力、SSL、物理展开重建与可微配准；21 个「需要理解」节点覆盖现代混合骨干、可提示分割、医学 VLM 与扩散/流匹配；7 个「知道即可」节点追踪快速演化前沿。

All foundational mechanisms and landmark architectures are organized into 47 competency nodes: 19 Tier-I (Must-Master) nodes covering convolutions, residual paths, U-Net/nnU-Net, self-attention, SSL, unrolled physics reconstruction, and differentiable registration; 21 Tier-II (Deep-Comprehension) nodes covering modern hybrid backbones, promptable segmentation, medical VLMs, and diffusion/flow matching; and 7 Tier-III (Frontier-Awareness) nodes tracking emerging paradigms.

Tier I · 必须精通Tier I · Must Master 19 / 47 (40.4%)

能力基准：能从结构图写出 forward/loss、推导时空复杂度、独立从零实现并设计公平医学消融实验。

Competency Standard: Derive forward/loss equations from diagrams, analyze space-time complexity, implement from scratch, and design fair ablations.

Tier II · 需要理解Tier II · Deep Comprehension 21 / 47 (44.7%)

能力基准：能精读原论文与官方代码、画出完整张量数据流、判断医学适用条件并设计外部验证。

Competency Standard: Audit primary literature and official codebases, trace full tensor shapes, identify clinical constraints, and design external validation.

Tier III · 知道即可Tier III · Working Awareness 07 / 47 (14.9%)

能力基准：掌握核心假设与当前临床证据边界；当具体课题直接涉及时再深入底层实现。

Competency Standard: Understand core hypotheses and current clinical evidence boundaries; dive into low-level implementation when directly required.

SECTION 03 // THREE EVOLUTIONARY AXES
ZH // 中文原著论述

三条主干演化逻辑

架构主干

AlexNet/VGG/Inception → ResNet/DenseNet → EfficientNet/ConvNeXt；同时 CNN → ViT/Swin → S4/Mamba。ConvNeXt/MedNeXt 与 MambaVision 提示长期结果更可能是局部卷积、层级结构和全局 mixer 的混合。

医学分割主干

FCN → U-Net/3D U-Net/V-Net → skip/attention 变体 → nnU-Net → UNETR/Swin UNETR → MedNeXt/U-Mamba → promptable 3D foundation segmentation。范式节点少于网络名称；多数 U-Net 小改不是换代。

生成与重建主干

image mapping/GAN → algorithm unrolling + data consistency → diffusion posterior → latent/DiT → flow matching/consistency + multi-operator prior。真正的进步标准是测量、解剖、定量与临床任务一致，而非只看视觉真实感。

EN // ENGLISH MONOGRAPH TEXT

Three Primary Evolutionary Lineages

01 // Representation Backbones

AlexNet / VGG / Inception → ResNet / DenseNet → EfficientNet / ConvNeXt, alongside CNN → ViT / Swin → S4 / Mamba. Modern pure ConvNets (ConvNeXt, MedNeXt) and hybrid architectures (MambaVision) demonstrate that the long-term equilibrium in biomedical vision is a synthesis of local convolutional priors, multi-scale hierarchy, and global token mixers.

02 // Dense Prediction & Medical Segmentation

FCN → U-Net / 3D U-Net / V-Net → Skip & Attention Variants → nnU-Net → UNETR / Swin UNETR → MedNeXt / U-Mamba → Promptable 3D Foundation Segmentation. True paradigm shifts are far rarer than named network variants; the vast majority of incremental U-Net block modifications do not constitute generational leaps.

03 // Generative Priors & Physics-Informed Reconstruction

Image Mapping / GAN → Algorithm Unrolling + Data Consistency → Diffusion Posterior Sampling → Latent / DiT → Flow Matching / Consistency + Multi-Operator Priors. Authentic progress is measured by joint consistency across raw measurements, anatomy, quantitative biomarkers (HU/SUV/ADC), and downstream clinical decisions—not visual sharpness alone.

SECTION 04 // THREE-LAYER SYSTEM DECOMPOSITION
ZH // 中文原著论述

医学 AI 系统的三层结构

完整系统可写为：输入/测量 → 表示骨干 → 任务接口 → 物理或几何校正 → 校准与人工复核。卷积、attention 与 Mamba 主要改变表示计算；MAE、DINO 与 CLIP 改变监督来源和迁移方式；U-Net、SAM 与 VLM 改变任务接口；MoDL、VarNet 和 differentiable DRR 把测量或几何约束带回计算图。

EN // ENGLISH MONOGRAPH TEXT

Three-Layer System Architecture of Biomedical AI

A complete biomedical AI system decomposes into: Acquisition / Measurement → Representation Backbone → Task Interface → Physical or Geometric Correction → Calibration & Human Audit. Convolutions, attention, and Mamba primarily alter representation compute; MAE, DINO, and CLIP transform supervision sources and transfer mechanics; U-Net, SAM, and VLMs redefine task interfaces; MoDL, VarNet, and differentiable DRR embed physical measurement and geometric operators directly back into the computation graph.

SECTION 05 // CROSS-PARADIGM LANDMARKS
ZH // 中文原著论述

关键模型与结构限制

ResNet 缩短深层优化路径，U-Net 联结语义与定位，Transformer 建立全局动态交互，nnU-Net 将空间配置、采样、训练和推理组织为可复现系统，MoDL 将测量一致性嵌入可训练迭代，CLIP、MAE 与 DINO 扩展了监督来源。

EN // ENGLISH MONOGRAPH TEXT

Cross-Paradigm Landmark Architectures & Structural Boundaries

ResNet shortens deep optimization paths via identity residuals; U-Net bridges high-level semantics with pixel-precise localization; Transformer establishes content-dependent global interactions; nnU-Net systematizes spatial configuration, sampling, training, and inference into a self-configuring pipeline; MoDL embeds forward measurement consistency into unrolled optimization; CLIP, MAE, and DINOv2 generalize visual supervision beyond manual labels.

SECTION 06 // CLINICAL TRANSLATION & EVIDENCE PROTOCOL
ZH // 中文原著论述

医学转化的核心判断

  • Transformer 没有取代 CNN：有限医学数据、极长 3D token、小病灶和 spacing 异质性使局部归纳偏置仍有优势。
  • nnU-Net 的启示比多数新 block 更深：预处理、空间配置、采样、增强、loss、推理和外部验证常比换模块更重要。
  • SAM/MedSAM 当前最可信角色是交互分割、标注和专科适配，不是无需提示的自动分割终点。
  • 医学 VLM 的语言流畅度不等于图像诊断正确；报告生成应有 grounding、provenance 和人工复核。
  • 重建、配准和 2D→3D 必须把 forward operator、geometry 与 null-space 风险放进方法与评价。
EN // ENGLISH MONOGRAPH TEXT

Core Tenets of Clinical Translation

  • Transformers have not obsoleted CNNs: Under finite medical cohorts, ultra-long 3D token sequences, subtle micro-lesions, and heterogeneous voxel spacing, local convolutional inductive biases remain highly competitive.
  • nnU-Net teaches a deeper lesson than most novel blocks: Preprocessing, anisotropic spacing rules, patch sampling, data augmentation, loss formulation, sliding-window inference, and external validation routinely outweigh isolated module swaps.
  • SAM and MedSAM excel at interactive human-in-the-loop workflows: Their most credible clinical role is annotation acceleration, interactive boundary refinement, and specialist adaptation—not unprompted autonomous segmentation.
  • Linguistic fluency in medical VLMs does not equal diagnostic truth: Automated radiology report generation requires spatial grounding, source provenance, and clinician sign-off.
  • Reconstruction, registration, and 2D-to-3D lifting must model physics: Forward operators, projection geometry, and null-space uncertainty must be explicitly integrated into both architecture design and evaluation.
ZH // 中文原著论述

范围与证据等级

  • 范围： 2012-01-01 至 2026-08-29；覆盖 CT、MRI、CBCT、PET、X-ray、超声、病理、眼底、ECG、EEG、PPG 与 EMG，以及分类、检测、分割、配准、姿态、重建、去噪、生成、2D↔3D、跨模态和时序任务。
  • 证据等级： E1 为机制原论文；E2 为医学方法验证；E3 为独立、多中心、读者或前瞻工作流证据；E4 为主要依赖预印本或作者内测的前沿结果。
  • 数据单位： patient、study、volume、series、slice、patch、mask 与 WSI 不能互换；训练规模和数据划分必须按真实独立单位解释。
EN // ENGLISH MONOGRAPH TEXT

Scoping Review Coverage & Evidence Hierarchy

  • Temporal & Modality Scope: January 1, 2012 through August 29, 2026; spanning CT, MRI, CBCT, PET, X-ray, Ultrasound, Computational Pathology (WSI), Fundus/OCT, ECG, EEG, PPG, and EMG across classification, detection, segmentation, registration, pose estimation, tomographic reconstruction, denoising, synthesis, 2D-to-3D lifting, multimodal fusion, and physiological time-series modeling.
  • Evidence Grading (E1–E4): E1 denotes foundational mechanism papers; E2 denotes domain-specific medical methodology validation; E3 denotes independent, multi-center, reader-study, or prospective clinical workflow evidence; E4 denotes emerging frontier preprints or internal author benchmarks.
  • Statistical Granularity: patient, study, volume, series, slice, patch, mask, and WSI are non-interchangeable denominators; training scale and evaluation splits must be audited at the true independent patient/study level.
SECTION 07 // COMPUTATIONAL PRIMITIVES: CONVOLUTION, ATTENTION & SSM
ZH // 中文原著论述

从局部卷积到全局注意力，再到选择性状态扫描

卷积的优势来自先验，而不是 3×3 这个数字。 y_o(p)=Σ_iΣ_δ W_{o,i,δ}x_i(p+δ)+b_o 同时施加局部连接、空间权重共享、近似平移等变和层级组合；在标注少、解剖局部连续、设备域差异大的医学数据上，这些先验能显著减少需要从数据学习的自由度。y=x+F(x) 的 residual identity path 让梯度包含一条不经过复杂变换的短路；它解决 block 级优化，不等同于 U-Net 将定位信息送到 decoder 的 long skip。ConvNeXt/MedNeXt 用大核 depthwise、inverted bottleneck 和现代归一化扩大视野，说明 attention 不是获得大感受野的唯一方法。

Attention 的能力来自输入相关的关系矩阵。 Attn(Q,K,V)=softmax(QKᵀ/√d_k)V 让每个 token 直接查询其他 token；全局路径长度为 1，但时间和显存随 N² 增长。ViT 的 patch embedding 同时是计算压缩和信息瓶颈：patch 太大，小病灶可能在进入 encoder 前被平均；Swin 用局部窗口、shift 和 patch merging 把复杂度拉回近线性，却把 window、层级和 spacing 变成新超参数。

Mamba 不保存 N×N 关系，而把历史压入有限状态。 离散 SSM 可写为 h_k=Āh_{k-1}+B̄x_k, y_k=Ch_k+Dx_k；selective Mamba 让写入、遗忘和读出参数依赖当前输入，并用并行 scan 实现长序列近线性混合。代价是二维/三维网格必须序列化，scan direction、状态瓶颈和细边界保持会影响结果。统一 3D 消融与独立边界评价因此支持“有价值的 global mixer”，而不是“已取代 CNN/Transformer”。

EN // ENGLISH MONOGRAPH TEXT

From Local Convolutions to Global Attention and Selective State Scans

The advantage of convolution stems from structural priors, not the number 3×3. The operator y_o(p)=Σ_iΣ_δ W_{o,i,δ}x_i(p+δ)+b_o simultaneously enforces local connectivity, spatial weight sharing, approximate translation equivariance, and hierarchical composition. Across small medical cohorts with locally continuous anatomy and cross-scanner domain shifts, these priors drastically shrink the effective hypothesis space. The residual identity path y=x+F(x) provides an unattenuated gradient highway across deep blocks; it resolves block-level optimization degradation and is functionally distinct from U-Net's long skip connections, which transport high-frequency spatial coordinates to the decoder. ConvNeXt and MedNeXt expand effective receptive fields via large-kernel depthwise convolutions, inverted bottlenecks, and modern normalization—proving self-attention is not the sole path to broad spatial context.

The expressive power of Attention lies in input-dependent affinity matrices. Attn(Q,K,V)=softmax(QKᵀ/√d_k)V enables every token to query all other tokens globally in O(1) path length, at the cost of O(N²) time and memory. ViT's patchify stem acts simultaneously as compute compression and an information bottleneck: overly coarse patches average out micro-calcifications or small metastases before encoding even begins. Swin restores near-linear scaling via local windows, shifted window partitioning, and patch merging, but introduces window size, hierarchy depth, and anisotropic voxel spacing as sensitive hyperparameters.

Mamba compresses history into a finite state rather than materializing an N×N matrix. A discrete state-space model evolves via h_k=Āh_{k-1}+B̄x_k, y_k=Ch_k+Dx_k; selective Mamba makes step size Δ, input projection B, and readout C content-dependent while executing in near-linear time via hardware-aware parallel associative scans. The trade-off is that 2D/3D anatomical grids must be serialized into 1D sequences, making scan ordering, state capacity bottlenecks, and fine boundary preservation critical failure modes. Controlled 3D ablations therefore support Mamba as a memory-efficient global mixer rather than a universal replacement for CNNs or Transformers.

SECTION 08 // DENSE PREDICTION & SELF-CONFIGURING PIPELINES
ZH // 中文原著论述

U-Net 的长寿来自信息路径；nnU-Net 的价值来自完整系统

FCN 把分类 CNN 的全连接头改成卷积和上采样，使整图 dense prediction 可端到端训练；U-Net 进一步用对称 encoder–decoder 解决“是什么”与“在哪里”的冲突。Encoder 的下采样扩大语义视野，decoder 恢复坐标，long skip 直接传送高分辨率边缘、小结构和位置。浅层外观特征与深层任务语义不一致形成 semantic gap，U-Net++ 的 nested skip 和 Attention U-Net 的 gate 都是在融合前选择或语义化这些特征；它们有工程价值，但没有改变 dense prediction 的基本问题。

3D U-Net/V-Net 把 kernel、pooling、augmentation 和 Dice 拓展到体数据，收益是原生形状连续性，代价是 activation、patch context 与 anisotropic spacing。Dice 抵抗前景稀疏，但不能单独保证边界、拓扑或病灶级召回。nnU-Net 的关键更彻底：由 dataset fingerprint 自动决定 normalization、spacing、patch/batch、2D/3D/cascade、loss、foreground sampling、增强、TTA 和后处理，把过去隐性的专家工程变成可复现 baseline。因而任何新分割架构都应先在相同 pipeline、训练预算和外部数据上战胜 nnU-Net ResEnc/MedNeXt。

Promptable segmentation 又改变了任务接口。SAM/MedSAM 把“要分什么”交给点、框或 mask prompt；VISTA3D 将自动 anatomy prior、点提示和 novel structure 纠错放入同一 3D 接口。当前最可信用途是标注加速、交互修正和专科适配，而非无需提示的自动分割终点。

EN // ENGLISH MONOGRAPH TEXT

U-Net Endures Through Information Topology; nnU-Net Prevails Through Holistic System Engineering

FCN converted classification CNNs into end-to-end dense predictors via fully convolutional heads and learned upsampling; U-Net resolved the fundamental tension between semantic recognition ("what") and spatial localization ("where") through a symmetric encoder–decoder coupled with same-scale concatenation long skips. Downsampling in the encoder expands semantic context, upsampling in the decoder restores coordinate resolution, and long skips directly transmit sharp edges, small vessels, and anatomical boundaries. Because shallow appearance features and deep semantic representations exhibit a semantic gap, U-Net++ nested dense skips and Attention U-Net spatial gates filter or align skip features prior to fusion—offering practical engineering gains without altering the core dense prediction paradigm.

3D U-Net and V-Net generalized kernels, pooling, elastic augmentations, and Dice-family objectives to volumetric data, capturing native 3D organ continuity at the expense of activation memory, restricted patch field-of-view, and anisotropic slice spacing. While Dice loss mitigates extreme foreground sparsity, it cannot alone guarantee boundary Hausdorff accuracy, topological genus preservation, or small-lesion recall. nnU-Net went further by deriving normalization, resampling spacing, patch/batch configuration, 2D/3D/cascade topology, foreground oversampling, data augmentation, test-time augmentation, and connected-component post-processing directly from a dataset fingerprint—codifying tacit expert heuristics into a reproducible scientific baseline. Any newly proposed segmentation architecture must therefore outperform nnU-Net ResEnc and MedNeXt under identical preprocessing, training budgets, and external multi-center cohorts.

Promptable segmentation reshaped the task interface itself. SAM and MedSAM decouple image encoding from point, box, or mask prompts; VISTA3D unifies 127-class automated 3D anatomical priors, 3D point prompts, and novel-structure zero-shot refinement within a single volumetric interface. Their highest-evidence clinical deployment today lies in interactive annotation acceleration, human-in-the-loop correction, and specialist fine-tuning rather than autonomous zero-prompt diagnosis.

SECTION 09 // PRETRAINING OBJECTIVES & TASK INTERFACES
ZH // 中文原著论述

Foundation model 的核心是监督信号与复用接口，不是参数量

对比学习用 InfoNCE 将同一实例的增强视图拉近、其他实例推远；医学中的关键不是照搬 RGB crop/flip，而是先定义哪些变化应保持病理语义、哪些患者/时间点不应成为 false negative。MAE 丢弃大量 patch，让 encoder 只处理可见 token，再由轻 decoder 恢复遮挡内容，特别适合 3D 与病理的空间冗余；但像素 MSE 可能偏向强度与低频结构。DINO/DINOv2 用 EMA teacher、自蒸馏和数据治理学习 dense/global feature，注意力图可以帮助对应，但不是因果解释。

CLIP 将影像和文本编码到共同空间，适合检索、zero-shot 与 linear probing；global embedding 并不天然提供局部定位。GLoRIA、BioViL 等通过 region–word 或专科语言建模加强 grounding。BLIP-2/LLaVA 类结构用 connector/Q-Former 把冻结视觉 encoder 接到 LLM，降低适配成本，却可能让语言先验压过图像证据。一个流畅报告可能来自常见模板，而非正确读取病灶。

下游适配应按数据规模与风险选择：linear probe 最能测表示本身；full fine-tuning 上限高但小数据易过拟合；adapter/LoRA 便于多中心版本管理；visual prompt、SAM 点框 prompt 和 CLIP 文本 prompt 是三种不同接口。无论 PEFT 多省参数，都不能自动修复患者泄漏、域偏移、缺失模态和校准。

EN // ENGLISH MONOGRAPH TEXT

Foundation Models Are Defined by Supervision Signals and Reuse Interfaces, Not Parameter Count

Contrastive learning (SimCLR, MoCo) uses InfoNCE to pull augmented views of the same instance together while pushing other instances apart; in medicine, success hinges not on copying natural-image RGB crops or flips, but on defining transformations that preserve pathological semantics while preventing same-patient or longitudinal scans from becoming false negatives. Masked Autoencoders (MAE) drop 75%+ of patches so the heavy encoder processes only visible tokens before a lightweight decoder reconstructs masked regions—exploiting spatial redundancy in 3D volumes and gigapixel WSI, though pixel MSE can bias representations toward low-frequency intensity statistics. DINO and DINOv2 combine EMA teacher self-distillation with curated data governance to learn dense local correspondence alongside global semantics; while self-attention maps aid visual inspection, they do not constitute causal explanations.

CLIP aligns images and text in a shared contrastive embedding space for retrieval, zero-shot classification, and linear probing, yet global embeddings lack fine-grained spatial localization. GLoRIA and BioViL strengthen local phrase grounding via region–word attention and radiology-specific language modeling (CXR-BERT). Connector-based MLLMs (BLIP-2, LLaVA-Med, MAIRA) bridge frozen vision encoders to LLMs via Q-Formers or MLP projectors, lowering adaptation cost but introducing the risk that strong autoregressive language priors override visual evidence—producing fluent templated narratives that hallucinate or miss subtle lesions.

Downstream adaptation must match cohort size and clinical risk: linear probing audits intrinsic representation quality; full fine-tuning maximizes ceiling performance but overfits on small cohorts; adapters and LoRA streamline multi-institutional version control; visual prompts, SAM spatial prompts, and CLIP text prompts serve fundamentally distinct operational interfaces. Regardless of parameter efficiency, PEFT cannot repair patient-level data leakage, scanner domain shift, missing modalities, or miscalibration.

SECTION 10 // 3D VOLUMETRIC ENGINEERING & INVERSE PROBLEM LADDER
ZH // 中文原著论述

3D 的难点不是把 Conv2d 换成 Conv3d，而是管理物理视野和 activation

2D 便于迁移 ImageNet/2D foundation encoder、batch 大，适合高各向异性数据与快速基线；2.5D 用相邻切片或三视图换取有限体上下文；3D 直接学习器官与病灶体形，却让 kernel 参数从 k²CinCout 增到 k³CinCout，更重要的是 encoder skip activation 必须为反传保存。256³ 体积约 1,680 万格点，512² 图像约 26 万格点，原始格点相差约 64 倍；这只是空间规模直觉，不等于完整训练显存比。

工程实现应以 physical spacing 为起点：厚层数据可用早期 anisotropic kernel/stride 或 2D/2.5D，盲目重采样到 isotropic 会制造插值细节。Patch training 要记录 physical patch size、foreground oversampling 和边界 padding；sliding-window inference 需用重叠与 Gaussian weighting 并验证 whole-volume 一致性。Mixed precision、checkpointing、depthwise/grouped 3D conv、window/axial attention、SSM 与 coarse-to-fine 都是在交换显存、延迟和物理视野。冻结 2D foundation encoder 加合理切片聚合可以在部分 3D 分类上很强，但不能外推为体素级分割或配准的普遍结论。

EN // ENGLISH MONOGRAPH TEXT

The Challenge of 3D Volumetric AI Is Managing Physical Field-of-View and Activation Memory, Not Replacing Conv2d with Conv3d

2D networks readily leverage ImageNet or 2D foundation encoders with large batch sizes, suiting highly anisotropic thick-slice acquisitions and rapid baselines; 2.5D stacks adjacent slices or tri-planar views for local inter-slice context; native 3D networks directly model volumetric morphology, but scale kernel parameters from k² C_{in} C_{out} to k³ C_{in} C_{out} and, crucially, must store high-resolution encoder skip activations in GPU memory for backpropagation. A 256³ volume contains ≈16.8M voxels versus ≈262K pixels in a 512² slice—a 64\times raw grid expansion that dictates memory ceilings long before parameter count does.

Volumetric engineering must begin from physical voxel spacing (mm): thick-slice scans warrant early anisotropic kernels/strides or hybrid 2D/3D designs, whereas blind resampling to isotropic grids fabricates interpolated artifacts. Patch-based training must log physical patch coverage (in mm³), foreground oversampling ratios, and boundary padding; sliding-window inference requires Gaussian-weighted overlap stitching and whole-volume consistency audits. Mixed precision (BF16/FP16), gradient checkpointing, depthwise/grouped 3D convolutions, windowed/axial attention, selective SSMs, and coarse-to-fine cascades all trade off memory footprint, latency, and physical receptive field. While frozen 2D foundation encoders paired with slice-level attention pooling perform strongly on study-level 3D classification, they do not generalize into a universal substitute for native 3D voxel segmentation or deformable registration.

ZH // 中文原著论述

医学重建先写 forward model，再决定网络

测量过程应先写成 y=A(x;φ)+ε：A 是 CT 投影、MRI Fourier/coil encoding、PET system matrix 或 X-ray 几何，φ 是设备、姿态与标定。纯图像映射只学 x̂=fθ(x_low)；physics-informed 方法求解数据项与学习先验的平衡。两者的区别不是多一个 loss，而是允许解集合不同。

Algorithm unrolling 把迭代步骤展开为可训练 cascade：x^(k+1)=Dθk(x^k−ηk A*(Ax^k−y))。A*(Ax−y) 把 measurement residual 回投图像域，denoiser/proximal 学统计先验；MoDL、VarNet、Learned Primal-Dual 因此把 measurement-space correction 与 image-space prior 清楚分工。欠定系统仍有 null space：若 An=0，则 x 与 x+n 产生相同测量，网络必须用训练分布选择其中一个解；罕见解剖仍可能被“修正”为常见形态。

Diffusion 用多噪声尺度回归学习 score 或 denoising field，训练比 GAN 稳定，可与 likelihood guidance 近似采样 p(x|y)；但多步采样、score OOD、guidance scale 与 operator mismatch 会改变结果。Flow matching 直接学习概率路径的 velocity，可用 ODE 和 consistency 少步求解，部署潜力高；截至 2026-08，医学临床 superiority 仍未证明。评价必须同时看 measurement residual、HU/SUV/ADC 等定量值、病灶插入/删除、读者任务、外部设备和不确定性校准。

EN // ENGLISH MONOGRAPH TEXT

Medical Image Reconstruction Begins by Formulating the Physical Forward Operator Before Choosing a Network

Every tomographic or k-space acquisition must first be written as y = A(x; φ) + ε, where A is the physical forward operator (CT Radon/cone-beam projection, multi-coil MRI Fourier encoding, PET system matrix, or X-ray perspective geometry) and φ captures scanner calibration, coil sensitivities, and patient pose. Pure image-domain post-processing learns only x̂ = f_θ(x_{\text{low}}), whereas physics-informed reconstruction balances measurement fidelity against learned statistical priors—fundamentally constraining the admissible solution set.

Algorithm unrolling unfolds iterative optimization into a differentiable K-stage cascade: x^{(k+1)} = D_{θ_k}(x^{(k)} - η_k A^*(Ax^{(k)} - y)). Here A^*(Ax - y) backprojects measurement residuals into image space while the learned proximal/denoiser network D_{θ_k} enforces anatomical priors. Architectures such as MoDL, Variational Network, VarNet, and Learned Primal-Dual cleanly partition measurement-space data consistency from image-space regularization. Yet ill-posed inverse problems inevitably possess a non-trivial null space: whenever An = 0, x and x + n yield identical measurements, forcing the network prior to select a plausible completion—which risks overwriting rare pathologies with training-set normality.

Diffusion models learn multi-scale score fields ∇_x log p_t(x) via stable denoising regression and couple with measurement likelihood gradients ∇_x log p(y|x) (e.g., DDRM, DPS, DDNM) to sample from the posterior p(x|y); however, high neural function evaluations (NFEs), out-of-distribution score drift, guidance step approximations, and operator mismatch remain active bottlenecks. Flow matching and consistency models learn straight ODE velocity fields or single-step trajectory endpoints for rapid inference, though clinical superiority over unrolled variational baselines remains unproven as of August 2026. Rigorous evaluation requires joint auditing of measurement residuals, quantitative accuracy (HU/SUV/ADC), lesion insertion/deletion recovery, blinded radiologist reader studies, cross-vendor generalization, and uncertainty calibration.

SECTION 11 // REGISTRATION, PROJECTIVE GEOMETRY, NERF/3DGS, GNN & TEMPORAL
ZH // 中文原著论述

当坐标、投影、拓扑、时间或模态关系是问题本体时，专门结构才有天然优势

Deformable registration 学习 φ 使 moving image 经 I_m∘φ 与 fixed image 对齐，并用相似度、平滑、Jacobian 或 inverse-consistency 约束 deformation。VoxelMorph 把逐对优化摊销成一次 forward；GradICON 更直接约束局部可逆性。评价不能只看 warped label Dice，还要有 TRE、folding、surface distance、inverse consistency 与外部病理。

2D/3D registration 把 CT attenuation、相机参数和 SE(3) pose 放入 differentiable DRR：网络提出初始化或多假设，物理投影验证并优化。单幅 X-ray→3D 则先天不可辨识；网络输出的是 measurement constraint 下最可能的 anatomy prior，不是从 2D 中“读出”真实隐藏 CT。Voxel、mesh、INR、diffusion/flow 可以表示不同类型的先验，但都必须重新投影、做 pose perturbation、病灶/表面/landmark 误差与多假设校准。

NeRF/GS 的真正价值是连续场、可微渲染与患者特异快速优化；X-ray 必须使用衰减/线积分物理，不能直接套 RGB alpha compositing。GNN 只有在血管、气道、mesh、分子或真实患者关系图中才天然；任意 kNN 患者图可能只是站点/年龄混杂。多模态与时序模型也必须显式处理预测时点、缺失、时间戳和模态可得性，否则 cross-attention 可能只学到泄漏。

EN // ENGLISH MONOGRAPH TEXT

Specialized Geometric, Topological, and Temporal Architectures Excel Only When Coordinates, Projections, Graphs, or Time Are Intrinsic to the Problem

Deformable registration estimates a spatial deformation field φ aligning a moving image I_m ∘ φ to a fixed image I_f under similarity (NCC/MI), smoothness, Jacobian determinant, or inverse-consistency constraints. VoxelMorph amortizes pairwise optimization into a single feed-forward pass; GradICON and uniGradICON enforce diffeomorphic regularity by penalizing deviations of the composed forward–backward Jacobian from identity. Evaluation must never rely solely on warped label Dice—it must report target registration error (TRE), percentage of non-positive Jacobian determinants (|J_φ| ≤ 0, folding), surface distances, inverse consistency, and robustness around space-occupying lesions.

2D/3D registration embeds CT attenuation volumes, intrinsic camera calibration, and rigid SE(3) pose into differentiable digitally reconstructed radiographs (DiffDRR / DeepDRR): learned networks propose pose initializations while physical ray-casting gradients refine alignment at test time. Conversely, single-view 2D X-ray to 3D CT reconstruction is mathematically non-identifiable; a generative network outputs an anatomical prior conditioned on 2D projection constraints rather than recovering hidden true 3D tomography. Whether parameterized via voxels, meshes, implicit neural representations (INRs), or diffusion/flow priors, all 2D-to-3D systems must enforce re-projection consistency, pose perturbation stability, landmark/surface error bounds, and multi-hypothesis uncertainty.

The true value of NeRF and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) in medicine lies in continuous coordinate fields, differentiable rendering, and rapid patient-specific optimization—provided visible-light RGB alpha compositing is rewritten into Beer–Lambert X-ray attenuation line integrals (as in NAF). Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) offer native inductive bias only when edges represent true anatomical topology (vascular/airway trees, cortical surface meshes, cell-graph histology); arbitrary k-NN patient similarity graphs often encode site or demographic confounders and require strict graph-free and randomized-edge ablations. Similarly, multimodal and physiological time-series architectures must explicitly model prediction index timestamps, non-random modality missingness, lead geometry, and causal receptive fields so cross-attention does not exploit temporal or administrative leakage.

ZH // 中文原著论述

从架构到应用：先问任务需要什么信息，再选模型

临床工作流不是统一 benchmark。图级分类关注检查级上下文、校准和域外错误；小病灶分割要求高分辨定位、病灶级召回与边界；重建需要 raw measurement、forward/adjoint 与定量一致；导航需要 pose capture range、几何标定和实时失败率；VLM 需要逐句事实、laterality、grounding 和人工复核；长 ECG/EEG 则需要采样率、事件边界、流式延迟和未见导联组合。下表把每类任务的强基线、可增加机制、评价与安全回退放在同一决策链中。

EN // ENGLISH MONOGRAPH TEXT

From Architecture to Clinical Workflow: Define the Required Identifiable Information Before Selecting a Model

Clinical workflows are not interchangeable leaderboard benchmarks. Study-level classification demands multi-series context, probability calibration, and out-of-distribution abstention; small-lesion segmentation requires high-resolution localization, lesion-wise recall, and boundary precision; tomographic reconstruction requires raw sensor/k-space access, exact forward/adjoint operators, and quantitative preservation; intraoperative navigation requires wide SE(3) capture ranges, geometric calibration, and bounded tail failure rates; clinical VLMs require sentence-level factuality, laterality accuracy, spatial grounding, and clinician sign-off; long-horizon ECG/EEG monitoring requires sampling-rate invariance, event boundary detection, streaming low latency, and unseen lead generalization. The decision matrix below unifies strong first-choice baselines, candidate advanced mechanisms, mandatory evaluation protocols, and safe clinical fallbacks across seven primary workflows.

SECTION 13 // EVIDENCE MATURITY & MINIMUM EVALUATION MATRIX
ZH // 中文原著论述

成熟度由证据闭环决定，而不是由新颖度或模型规模决定

A 级技术已成为可复现基础设施；B 级已有跨任务长期价值但仍需任务适配；C 级机制真实、速度快、数据规模上升，尚缺广泛独立或工作流证据；D 级不是“错误”，而是现有结论超出了证据。病理 foundation model 的独立多队列 benchmark 已显示数据多样性与模型互补可能比单一参数规模更重要；3D 分割的同构消融又显示换成 Mamba 不必然带来独立增益。任何“foundation、SOTA、clinical-ready”主张都应落到患者级划分、强基线、外部数据、任务相关指标、效率、校准和失败回退。

EN // ENGLISH MONOGRAPH TEXT

Technological Maturity Is Governed by Closed-Loop Clinical Evidence, Not Novelty or Parameter Scale

Tier A (Infrastructure) technologies represent reproducible scientific foundations and mandatory baselines; Tier B (Long-Term Value) mechanisms provide validated cross-task utility but require domain-specific engineering; Tier C (Rapidly Advancing) paradigms demonstrate genuine algorithmic or scaling breakthroughs yet lack broad independent multi-center or workflow proof; Tier D (Unsettled Frontier) claims exceed current empirical validation. Independent multi-cohort pathology benchmarks have already shown that pretraining data diversity and ensemble complementarity often outweigh raw parameter count, while controlled 3D segmentation ablations show that swapping convolutions for Mamba blocks does not automatically yield standalone gains under matched nnU-Net pipelines. Every claim of "foundation", "SOTA", or "clinical readiness" must be audited against patient-level splits, strong baselines, external cohorts, task-specific safety metrics, compute efficiency, calibration, and fallback protocols.

ZH // 中文原著论述

单一平均指标无法回答医学安全问题

Dice 可能提高而 HD95、细结构或拓扑变差；SSIM 可能很好而病灶被抹去；报告自动指标可能提高而 laterality 或否定关系错误；平均 TRE 可能掩盖 capture range 外的灾难性失败。评价矩阵必须与任务的可辨识信息和决策用途对应，并把 worst case、亚组、外部中心、设备/协议/OOD 与人工工作流放进设计。

EN // ENGLISH MONOGRAPH TEXT

Single Aggregate Metrics Cannot Guarantee Clinical Safety

Mean Dice can rise while 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95), thin vascular topology, or small-lesion recall degrades; SSIM can appear high while a low-contrast tumor is smoothed away; automated BLEU/ROUGE report scores can improve while anatomical laterality or negation is inverted; mean TRE can mask catastrophic registration failures outside the capture range. A trustworthy evaluation matrix must align directly with the identifiable physical information and clinical decision risk of each task—explicitly auditing worst-case tails, demographic/scanner subgroups, external institutions, out-of-distribution shifts, and human-in-the-loop workflow impact.

SECTION 14 // CHRONOLOGICAL ARCHIVE (1997–2026)

医学与生物医学 AI 架构年代学编年表（137 个模型按发表年份索引） Chronological Archive of 137 Biomedical AI Architectures (1997–2026)

点击任意年份柱状条可过滤对应年份发表的代表性架构，点击模型标题可调阅完整规格说明书。

Select any year bar to filter architectures published in that year, or click a model title to open its complete specification sheet.

19971 ARCHITECTURES
SPEC 077Neural Computation16 · 生理时序与波形模型Temporal Physiological AI

带门控的加性 cell memory 与 recurrent hidden state 分离，使长期信息可选择性保留和读出。

Separates an additive linear cell memory state c_t (governed by forget and input gates) from the non-linear recurrent hidden state h_t to preserve long-term temporal gradients.

证据边界： 仍是低数据序列基线；串行训练慢且长窗口扩展有限

EVIDENCE: Reliable low-data sequential baseline; sequential step-by-step recurrence prevents parallel training across ultra-long multi-thousand-sample waveforms.

20061 ARCHITECTURES
SPEC 043Science10 · 生成、扩散与流匹配Generative, Diffusion & Flow

逐层 RBM 生成式预训练初始化深层对称 encoder–decoder，再以全局重建误差微调非线性 bottleneck。

Layer-by-layer Restricted Boltzmann Machine (RBM) generative pretraining initializing a deep symmetric encoder–decoder fine-tuned via global reconstruction error.

证据边界： 思想基础；普通 AE 的采样、不确定性和 L2 模糊有限

EVIDENCE: Historical foundation; deterministic L2 autoencoders blur high-frequency details and lack a tractable generative sampling density.

20121 ARCHITECTURES
SPEC 001NeurIPS01 · CNN 主干与现代卷积CNN Backbones

以 GPU、ReLU、dropout 和深卷积组合首次规模化训练 ImageNet 级深 CNN。

First large-scale ImageNet-grade deep CNN trained end-to-end by combining dual-GPU parallelism, non-saturating ReLU activations, dropout regularization, and stacked convolutions.

证据边界： 历史里程碑；不再是医学强基线

EVIDENCE: Historical milestone; superseded as a competitive medical backbone.

20142 ARCHITECTURES
SPEC 044NeurIPS10 · 生成、扩散与流匹配Generative, Diffusion & Flow

生成器与判别器通过同一 value function 对抗优化，以数据驱动判别器替代固定重建损失。

Generator and discriminator networks engage in a two-player minimax game, replacing hand-crafted pixel reconstruction losses with a learned adversarial critic.

证据边界： 历史基础；mode collapse、训练不稳和 hallucination 风险突出

EVIDENCE: Foundational generative paradigm; training instability, mode collapse, and anatomically unfaithful hallucinations pose severe clinical risks.

SPEC 136EMNLP16 · 生理时序与波形模型Temporal Physiological AI

GRU 用 reset/update 两门和单一隐藏状态完成记忆更新，结构比 LSTM 更简洁。

Simplifies gated recurrence by merging cell and hidden states into a single vector h_t interpolated via an update gate z_t and a reset gate r_t.

证据边界： 仍是轻量时序基线；串行计算和超长依赖能力弱于现代并行模型

EVIDENCE: Lightweight recurrent baseline; like LSTM, remains bottlenecked by sequential step-by-step training on ultra-long sequences.

20155 ARCHITECTURES
SPEC 005CVPR02 · 稠密预测与医学分割Dense Segmentation

FC→Conv 的整图 dense prediction，加 pool3/pool4 分数级 skip fusion。

Converts image-level FC layers into 1×1 convolutions for arbitrary-size dense prediction with pool3/pool4 skip score fusion.

证据边界： 范式基础；具体结构已被更强解码器替代

EVIDENCE: Foundational dense-prediction paradigm; asymmetric score-only upsampling is superseded by symmetric U-Net decoders.

SPEC 006MICCAI02 · 稠密预测与医学分割Dense Segmentation

对称 U 形多尺度解码器与 encoder–decoder 同尺度 concat long skips。

Symmetric U-shaped multi-scale decoder coupled with same-scale encoder–decoder channel concatenation long skips.

证据边界： 领域基础设施；必须从零实现和保留为强基线

EVIDENCE: Cornerstone domain infrastructure; mandatory to master from scratch and retain as a primary baseline.

SPEC 066NeurIPS13 · 可微配准与投影几何Registration & SE(3)

定位网络预测变换参数，grid generator 与可微 sampler 将任务梯度传回几何坐标。

Predicts geometric transformation parameters θ via a localization network, generates a transformed sampling grid, and warps feature maps via a differentiable sampler.

证据边界： 基础设施；本身不保证变换平滑、可逆或物理合理

EVIDENCE: Essential differentiable geometry primitive; requires explicit regularization when generalized from low-DOF affine to dense displacement fields.

SPEC 081ICLR01 · CNN 主干与现代卷积CNN Backbones

以高度同质的 3×3 plain-convolution blocks 规律加深到 16/19 层，无残差连接。

Homogeneous stacking of 3×3 plain convolutional blocks systematically deepened to 16–19 layers without residual shortcuts.

证据边界： 历史主干与表征参照；参数量大、缺残差连接，现已少作首选

EVIDENCE: Historical reference and perceptual loss extractor; heavy FC parameters and lack of residual paths limit modern primary use.

SPEC 082CVPR01 · CNN 主干与现代卷积CNN Backbones

在每个 Inception module 中并行执行 1×1、降维后 3×3/5×5 和 pooling 分支，再通道拼接。

Parallel multi-scale branches (1×1, bottlenecked 3×3, 5×5 convolutions, and pooling) concatenated within each Inception module.

证据边界： 多尺度设计仍重要；原始模块已被更简洁的残差和层级结构取代

EVIDENCE: Multi-scale branching remains influential, though complex hand-tuned Inception topologies are largely superseded by residual/ConvNeXt blocks.

20164 ARCHITECTURES
SPEC 002CVPR01 · CNN 主干与现代卷积CNN Backbones

显式 identity shortcut 与残差相加 y=x+F(x)。

Explicit identity shortcut connections combined with additive residual learning y = x + F(x).

证据边界： 仍是必须精通的强主干和公平对照

EVIDENCE: Mandatory foundational backbone and fair baseline across 2D and 3D biomedical tasks.

SPEC 007MICCAI02 · 稠密预测与医学分割Dense Segmentation

把 U-Net 的卷积、池化、上采样和 long skip 全部扩展为原生 3D，并支持稀疏切片监督。

Extends all U-Net convolutions, pooling, upsampling, and long skips to native 3D tensors with support for sparse slice annotations.

证据边界： 经典 3D 基线；显存、patch context 与各向异性仍是瓶颈

EVIDENCE: Canonical 3D baseline; bounded by GPU activation memory, patch field-of-view, and anisotropic slice spacing.

SPEC 0083DV02 · 稠密预测与医学分割Dense Segmentation

3D residual FCN 与直接可微 Dice overlap objective 的结合。

Volumetric 3D residual encoder–decoder trained directly with a differentiable Dice overlap objective.

证据边界： 经典强基线；并非唯一 3D 默认网络

EVIDENCE: Classic 3D baseline; Dice loss alone remains insensitive to boundary Hausdorff outliers and topological breaks.

SPEC 114NeurIPS12 · 去噪与图像恢复Denoising & Restoration

相较普通 autoencoder，RED-Net 在每个镜像卷积—反卷积层之间建立对称加法 skip，而不只保留少数 U-Net 尺度跳连。

Deep symmetric convolutional–deconvolutional autoencoder connected by layer-by-layer additive residual skip connections at every mirrored depth.

证据边界： 历史恢复基线；缺显式成像物理与现代注意力建模

EVIDENCE: Historically influential in low-dose CT denoising; purely image-domain L2 training can still over-smooth low-contrast liver lesions.

201710 ARCHITECTURES
SPEC 003CVPR01 · CNN 主干与现代卷积CNN Backbones

每层对所有前层输出做通道 concat，而非仅连接相邻层或做残差相加。

Every layer concatenates feature maps from all preceding layers along the channel axis rather than summing adjacent residuals.

证据边界： 结构思想仍有价值，但 activation memory 较大

EVIDENCE: Enduring architectural principle, though channel concatenation incurs high GPU activation memory in 3D.

SPEC 020NeurIPS04 · 视觉 TransformerVision Transformers

无递归的多头 self-attention encoder 与 masked self-/cross-attention decoder。

Recurrence-free multi-head self-attention encoder paired with a masked self- and cross-attention decoder.

证据边界： 基础设施级方法；高分辨 3D 仍受 O(N²) 限制

EVIDENCE: Universal deep learning infrastructure; direct application to dense 3D voxels is bottlenecked by O(N²) attention complexity.

SPEC 045CVPR10 · 生成、扩散与流匹配Generative, Diffusion & Flow

以 U-Net 生成器保持逐像素空间对应，70×70 conditional PatchGAN 学局部真实感，并用配对 L1 锚定结构。

Pairs a U-Net generator (preserving pixel-level spatial alignment) with a 70×70 conditional PatchGAN discriminator and paired L1 structural anchoring.

证据边界： 强 mapping 基线；不保证测量一致，可能生成逼真但错误结构

EVIDENCE: Strong paired image-translation baseline; remains an image-domain mapping without physical sensor consistency guarantees.

SPEC 046ICCV10 · 生成、扩散与流匹配Generative, Diffusion & Flow

双生成器、双 PatchGAN 与 X→Y→X / Y→X→Y 两个 cycle L1 闭环，使不成对域转换可训练。

Couples dual generators (G: X→Y, F: Y→X) and dual PatchGAN discriminators with forward and backward L1 cycle-consistency loops for unpaired translation.

证据边界： 探索与 style transfer 仍有用；cycle 不保证解剖或定量值保持

EVIDENCE: Useful for exploratory domain adaptation, but cycle consistency is under-constrained and can hallucinate or erase lesions when pathology prevalence differs across domains.

SPEC 047IEEE Transactions on Image Processing11 · 物理约束医学重建Physics-Informed Recon

解析 FBP 与单次残差 U-Net 串联，而非端到端替代投影算子或进行 unrolled data consistency。

Cascades analytical Filtered Backprojection (FBP) with a multi-scale residual U-Net in the image domain to remove sparse-view streaking artifacts.

证据边界： 历史与实用价值高；推理后无 projection data consistency

EVIDENCE: High practical speed and historical impact, but enforces zero projection-domain data consistency at inference—risking hallucinated or smoothed subtle lesions.

SPEC 052IEEE Transactions on Image Processing12 · 去噪与图像恢复Denoising & Restoration

深 CNN 回归噪声残差，再与输入显式相减，而非直接回归 clean image。

Trains a deep plain CNN with BatchNorm and ReLU to regress the additive noise residual R_θ(y) ≈ n rather than the clean image, recovering x̂ = y − R_θ(y).

证据边界： 基础设施级 baseline；原版 AWGN 与 BatchNorm 假设不匹配真实医学噪声

EVIDENCE: Foundational restoration baseline; i.i.d. AWGN assumptions fail on spatially correlated CT sinogram streaks or Poisson PET noise without domain adaptation.

SPEC 075ICLR15 · 图神经网络与医学拓扑Graph & Mesh Networks

以加自环的对称归一化邻接执行共享线性变换后的固定权重邻居聚合。

First-order spectral graph convolution approximation that aggregates 1-hop neighbor features weighted by the symmetrically normalized adjacency matrix with self-loops.

证据边界： GNN 基础；深层 over-smoothing 与构图泄漏需警惕

EVIDENCE: Core GNN baseline; stacking many GCN layers causes over-smoothing, and transductive patient-similarity graphs risk severe cohort leakage.

SPEC 083CVPR01 · CNN 主干与现代卷积CNN Backbones

在 residual bottleneck 中以 cardinality 控制的 grouped 3×3 convolution 聚合多个等拓扑变换。

Aggregates multiple homogeneous residual branches via grouped 3×3 convolutions governed by a cardinality hyperparameter.

证据边界： grouped convolution 已成现代 CNN 基础构件；原始主干不是当前唯一强基线

EVIDENCE: Grouped/depthwise convolution is now a permanent staple of modern CNNs.

SPEC 120ICLR10 · 生成、扩散与流匹配Generative, Diffusion & Flow

RealNVP 以三角 Jacobian 的 affine coupling 获得同时精确可逆、可采样且可算 log-likelihood 的映射。

Constructs an exactly invertible normalizing flow using stacked affine coupling layers whose triangular Jacobians permit O(D) log-determinant and exact likelihood evaluation.

证据边界： normalizing flow 基础；coupling 表达受限且高维似然未必对应临床异常

EVIDENCE: Foundational normalizing flow; coupling layers require deep stacking for expressivity and raw pixel likelihoods often mis-score semantic OOD anomalies.

SPEC 132NeurIPS15 · 图神经网络与医学拓扑Graph & Mesh Networks

GraphSAGE 学的是可应用到新节点的聚合器，并用固定邻居采样实现归纳式 mini-batch GNN。

EVIDENCE: Major sequence modeling milestone; in 2D/3D medical imaging, standalone superiority over tuned CNNs/Transformers is not universal.

SPEC 017NeurIPS03 · 状态空间与 MambaState Space & Mamba

SS2D 将二维网格沿四个方向 selective scan 后再逆映射融合。

2D Selective Scan (SS2D) unfolds spatial feature maps along four directional traversal paths, applies selective SSMs, and merges them back.

证据边界： 重要视觉 SSM 基线；未普遍淘汰 ConvNeXt/Swin

EVIDENCE: Important visual SSM baseline; native 3D volumetric extension requires tri-axial or multi-directional scan adaptations.

SPEC 018arXiv preprint03 · 状态空间与 MambaState Space & Mamba

在 nnU-Net 风格 residual CNN encoder/bottleneck 中插入 selective SSM，同时保留 CNN long skips。

证据边界： 高热度研究基线；后续统一配方消融未发现稳定的 Mamba 独立增益

EVIDENCE: High-visibility hybrid baseline, though subsequent controlled ablations show matched MedNeXt / nnU-Net ResEnc often perform comparably.

SPEC 019MICCAI03 · 状态空间与 MambaState Space & Mamba

GSC + Tri-oriented Mamba 的 TSMamba block，以及 FUE 过滤的多尺度 skip。

Combines Gated Spatial Convolution (GSC) with Tri-oriented Mamba (ToM) scans along axial, coronal, and sagittal axes plus Feature Uncertainty Estimation (FUE) skips.

证据边界： 值得复现；仍缺统一配方、多中心和边界/小病灶证据

EVIDENCE: Worth reproducing as a 3D SSM reference; still requires broader multi-center and boundary-level validation.

Combines automated deduplication/retrieval curation (LVD-142M) with a composite DINO + iBOT + KoLeo objective and multi-resolution distillation.

证据边界： 强通用特征底座；自然图像域不能自动覆盖灰阶、3D 和微小病灶

EVIDENCE: Gold-standard frozen visual feature extractor; natural-image weights still benefit from in-domain medical adaptation for 3D/grayscale.

SECTION 01 // CNN Backbones DISPLAYING 9 OF 9 SPECIFICATIONS

I. CNN 主干：从大规模分类到现代卷积 CNN Backbones: From Large-Scale Classification to Modern Pure ConvNets

局部连接、权重共享和层级下采样构成 CNN 的核心空间先验。残差路径改善深层优化，大核与 depthwise 结构扩大有效视野，通道重标定改变特征选择；医学迁移中的稳定收益还依赖归一化、数据规模和训练配方。

Local connectivity, spatial weight sharing, and hierarchical downsampling form the foundational inductive prior of CNNs. Residual identity paths resolve deep optimization degradation, large depthwise kernels expand effective receptive fields, and channel recalibration refines feature selection; stable medical transfer further depends on normalization choices, cohort scale, and modern training recipes.

SECTION 02 // Dense Segmentation DISPLAYING 15 OF 15 SPECIFICATIONS

II. 稠密预测与医学分割：从像素输出到自配置系统 Dense Prediction & Medical Segmentation: From Pixel Classification to Self-Configuring Systems

分割网络同时处理语义、坐标、边界和小结构。Encoder 压缩上下文，decoder 恢复空间分辨率，long skip 传递定位信息，loss 处理前景稀疏，pipeline 决定物理尺度；nnU-Net 将架构、spacing、patch、采样和推理策略纳入同一系统。

Medical segmentation networks must simultaneously resolve high-level semantics, continuous coordinates, sharp boundaries, and sparse micro-structures. Encoders compress context, decoders restore spatial resolution, long skips preserve localization, overlap losses counter extreme foreground imbalance, and system pipelines govern physical voxel scaling—culminating in nnU-Net's automated end-to-end configuration.

SECTION 03 // State Space & Mamba DISPLAYING 5 OF 5 SPECIFICATIONS

III. 状态空间与 Mamba：长程传播、扫描偏置和 3D 代价 State Space Models & Mamba: Long-Range Propagation, Scan Ordering Bias, and 3D Trade-Offs

SSM 通过隐藏状态递推传播长程信息，Mamba 使状态更新依赖当前输入，从而避免显式构造 N×N 注意力矩阵。医学 2D/3D 中的 raster、双向、四向或轴向扫描会改变空间归纳偏置；线性 token 复杂度不等于边界质量、域外稳健性或临床优势。

State-space models propagate long-range context through recurrent hidden states, while Mamba makes state transitions input-selective to avoid materializing quadratic N×N attention matrices. In 2D/3D medical imaging, raster, bi-directional, four-way, or tri-axial scan serializations alter spatial inductive biases; linear token complexity does not automatically translate into superior boundary precision or clinical robustness.

SECTION 04 // Vision Transformers DISPLAYING 5 OF 5 SPECIFICATIONS

IV. 视觉 Transformer：全局交互、层级窗口与高分辨率代价 Vision Transformers: Global Token Interaction, Hierarchical Windows, and High-Resolution Cost

Self-attention 用 Q/K/V 让 token 按内容选择其他 token，最短全局交互路径为一层，但时间和显存通常随 token 数近似二次增长。ViT 强调纯 token 化，DeiT 强调训练配方，PVT 与 Swin 引入金字塔、局部窗口和下采样以支持检测与分割。

Self-attention uses Q/K/V projections so every token dynamically queries all other tokens with O(1) path length, at the cost of quadratic O(N²) time and memory scaling. ViT establishes pure patch tokenization, DeiT refines data-efficient distillation recipes, and PVT/Swin introduce multi-scale pyramids and shifted local windows to support dense detection and segmentation.

SECTION 05 // Self-Supervised Learning DISPLAYING 9 OF 9 SPECIFICATIONS

V. 自监督学习：对比、聚类、自蒸馏与遮挡重建 Self-Supervised Representation Learning: Contrastive, Clustering, Self-Distillation & Masked Modeling

自监督学习从同一样本的不同视图、teacher–student 一致性、聚类分配或被遮挡内容构造训练目标。医学增强必须保护病灶、患者身份、序列关系和物理强度；目标函数与下游任务所需信息是否一致，比权重规模更重要。

Self-supervised learning constructs supervision from cross-view invariance, EMA teacher–student distillation, online prototype clustering, or masked token reconstruction. Medical augmentations must preserve lesion morphology, patient identity boundaries, multi-sequence relationships, and physical intensity calibration; alignment between the pretraining objective and downstream task granularity outweighs raw model size.

SPEC 024 / 137 / 2020 / ICML / siamese_contrastive_pretraining
FAMILY 05 · 自监督学习：对比、聚类、自蒸馏与遮挡重建Self-Supervised Learning

SimCLR

无动量教师或队列，以大 batch 内的两视图实例对和非线性投影头训练 NT-Xent。

SECTION 06 // Promptable Segmentation DISPLAYING 3 OF 3 SPECIFICATIONS

VI. 可提示分割：交互式目标定义与纠错 Promptable Interactive Segmentation: Spatial Target Specification & Human-in-the-Loop Refinement

Promptable segmentation 将图像编码与点、框、掩膜提示分离，并由轻量 mask decoder 组合输出，同一图像特征可被反复查询和修正。医学应用集中在标注、交互纠错和候选结构发现；box 依赖、逐切片 3D、一致性、细血管拓扑和域外校准决定其安全边界。

Promptable segmentation decouples heavy image encoding from lightweight point, bounding-box, and mask prompts via a fast two-way attention mask decoder, allowing cached image embeddings to be queried interactively. Clinical utility centers on annotation acceleration, interactive error correction, and specialist adaptation—bounded by box dependency, slice-wise 3D inconsistency, and thin-structure topology.

SECTION 07 // Vision-Language Models DISPLAYING 16 OF 16 SPECIFICATIONS

VII. 图文对齐与生成式 VLM：开放语义与视觉事实 Vision–Language Alignment & Generative Medical VLMs: Open-Vocabulary Semantics vs. Visual Grounding

CLIP 类双编码器通过图文对比学习共享空间，支持检索、zero-shot 和少标签迁移；BLIP、Q-Former 与 LLaVA 类模型把视觉编码连接到语言模型。全局语义对齐、区域—词语 grounding 和语言生成是不同能力，文本流畅不能证明异常来自图像证据。

CLIP-style dual encoders align images and text in a shared contrastive space for retrieval, zero-shot transfer, and linear probing, whereas BLIP, Q-Former, and LLaVA-style architectures bridge visual tokens into autoregressive LLMs. Global semantic alignment, local phrase–region grounding, and fluent text generation are distinct capabilities; narrative fluency never guarantees visual diagnostic fidelity.

SECTION 08 // Pathology Foundations DISPLAYING 7 OF 7 SPECIFICATIONS

VIII. 病理基础模型：从 patch encoder 到 whole-slide 多模态推理 Computational Pathology Foundation Models: From Tile Encoders to Gigapixel Whole-Slide Multimodal Reasoning

全切片病理包含十亿像素级空间、稀疏病灶和 slide-level 标签。典型系统先预训练 patch encoder，再用 MIL、层级 attention 或长序列聚合器形成 WSI 表征，并接入报告与问答模块；patch、slide、patient 和 report 数量代表不同训练规模。

Whole-slide images (WSIs) span gigapixel spatial dimensions with sparse diagnostic regions and slide-level weak supervision. Modern pathology systems pretrain self-supervised tile encoders (DINOv2/iBOT) on hundreds of millions of patches, aggregate slide context via MIL, hierarchical attention, or dilated LongNet transformers, and couple with pathology reports for multimodal reasoning.

SECTION 10 // Generative, Diffusion & Flow DISPLAYING 20 OF 20 SPECIFICATIONS

X. 生成模型：从潜变量与对抗学习到 diffusion、flow 与 consistency Generative Priors: From Latent Autoencoders & GANs to Diffusion, Flow Matching & Consistency Models

VAE 压缩潜变量，GAN 用判别器塑造样本，diffusion/score 学习逐步去噪或分数场，flow matching 与 rectified flow 学习连续速度场，consistency 追求少步映射。医学逆问题还需要 measurement likelihood、forward operator 和定量评价，视觉逼真度不能排除幻觉。

VAEs compress continuous latent manifolds, GANs shape distributions via adversarial discriminators, diffusion/score models learn multi-scale denoising vector fields, flow matching regresses straight ODE transport velocities, and consistency models distill one-step trajectory endpoints. In medical inverse problems, generative priors must be coupled with measurement likelihoods and audited against hallucinations.

SECTION 11 // Physics-Informed Recon DISPLAYING 7 OF 7 SPECIFICATIONS

XI. 物理约束重建：展开优化与测量一致性 Physics-Informed Tomographic Reconstruction: Unrolled Optimization & Measurement Data Consistency

医学重建从 y=A(x)+ε 出发。后处理网络只在图像域修饰初始重建；algorithm unrolling 交替执行 learned prior/proximal 与 A/A* 驱动的数据一致性更新。测量约束能排除明显冲突，但不能证明 null space 中由先验补入的内容属于患者真实解剖。

Medical reconstruction begins from y = A(x) + ε. Whereas image-domain post-processing merely polishes initial analytic reconstructions (FBP/IFFT), algorithm unrolling alternates learned proximal/denoiser priors with explicit A/A* data-consistency updates. While measurement constraints rule out gross data violations, they cannot alone guarantee that null-space features synthesized by the prior reflect true patient anatomy.

Learns the sensor-to-image domain transform directly via large fully connected layers mapping flattened raw measurements to an image grid followed by sparse convolutional refinement.

SECTION 12 // Denoising & Restoration DISPLAYING 7 OF 7 SPECIFICATIONS

XII. 去噪与图像恢复：残差、盲点与长程建模 Denoising & Image Restoration: Residual Learning, Blind-Spot Self-Supervision & Long-Range Attention

去噪方法依赖 clean/noisy 配对、同一潜在图像的独立噪声对，或 blind-spot/J-invariance 假设。CNN、Swin 与 Restormer 改善空间聚合；缺少 forward operator 时仍属于 image mapping。医学评价还需覆盖病灶保留、纹理/NPS、HU/SUV/ADC 和跨设备剂量泛化。

Restoration networks rely on paired clean/noisy acquisitions, independent noisy realizations of the same anatomy (Noise2Noise), or blind-spot J-invariance assumptions (Noise2Self/Noise2Void). Residual CNNs, SwinIR, and Restormer improve spatial-channel aggregation, but without an explicit forward operator they remain image-space mappings requiring strict audits of lesion contrast, NPS texture, and quantitative HU/SUV preservation.

SPEC 052 / 137 / 2017 / IEEE Transactions on Image Processing / residual_noise_cnn
FAMILY 12 · 去噪与图像恢复：残差、盲点与长程建模的假设边界Denoising & Restoration

DnCNN

深 CNN 回归噪声残差，再与输入显式相减，而非直接回归 clean image。

Trains a deep plain CNN with BatchNorm and ReLU to regress the additive noise residual R_θ(y) ≈ n rather than the clean image, recovering x̂ = y − R_θ(y).

INPUT DOMAIN // 输入域 含噪图像 y=x+n Noisy observation y = x + n
OUTPUT TARGET // 输出目标 去噪图像 x_hat=y-R_theta(y) Denoised image estimate x̂ = y − R_θ(y)
INSPECT ORIGINAL FIGURE (Figure 1 · PDF p.4)

医学适配：广泛作为低剂量 CT、PET、X-ray 和 MRI 去噪基线

Medical Translation: Universal lightweight baseline for low-dose CT, planar X-ray, ultrasound, and MRI image-space denoising.

适用边界：基础设施级 baseline；原版 AWGN 与 BatchNorm 假设不匹配真实医学噪声

Evidence Boundary: Foundational restoration baseline; i.i.d. AWGN assumptions fail on spatially correlated CT sinogram streaks or Poisson PET noise without domain adaptation.

SPEC 053 / 137 / 2018 / ICML / paired_noisy_self_supervision
FAMILY 12 · 去噪与图像恢复：残差、盲点与长程建模的假设边界Denoising & Restoration

Noise2Noise

使用同一信号的两次独立无偏噪声实现进行 noisy-to-noisy 监督，训练阶段不需要干净靶图。

Trains a denoising network using pairs of independent noisy realizations (y_1, y_2) of the same underlying anatomy without ever observing clean ground truth.

INPUT DOMAIN // 输入域 同一潜在图像 x 的两次独立含噪观测 y1、y2 Two independent noisy observations (y_1, y_2) of the exact same underlying clean signal x
OUTPUT TARGET // 输出目标 以单次含噪观测为输入的条件均值估计 x_hat Clean conditional expectation estimate x̂ = f_θ(y_1)
INSPECT ORIGINAL FIGURE (Official repository network.py, lines 59–114 · PDF p.Repository source lines 59–114)

医学适配：可用于拆分 PET counts、MRI k-space 或可重复低剂量测量

Medical Translation: Directly applicable to splitting list-mode PET counts, multi-NEX MRI averages, dose-split CT projections, and cryo-EM / fluorescence microscopy.

适用边界：长期有用；独立性、运动和 uptake mismatch 会造成目标偏差

Evidence Boundary: Enduring mathematical principle; breaks down if inter-scan patient motion occurs or if noise realizations share correlated bias.

SPEC 054 / 137 / 2019 / ICML / single_image_j_invariant_denoising
FAMILY 12 · 去噪与图像恢复：残差、盲点与长程建模的假设边界Denoising & Restoration

Noise2Self

通过 J-invariant 遮挡使单幅 noisy image 同时提供输入与 held-out 监督目标。

Formalizes single-image self-supervised denoising via J-invariant functions whose prediction for pixel subset J does not depend on the observed noisy values in J.

INPUT DOMAIN // 输入域 单幅含噪图像 y Single noisy image y (no paired second scan and no clean ground truth)
OUTPUT TARGET // 输出目标 由多次 J-invariant 预测聚合的去噪图像 x_hat Denoised image x̂ predicted from J-invariant masked neighborhoods
INSPECT ORIGINAL FIGURE (Figure 1 · PDF p.2)

医学适配：可用于显微、PET、MRI 等无 clean target 场景

Medical Translation: Used in single-shot fluorescence microscopy, low-count nuclear medicine, and unrepeatable dynamic medical acquisitions.

适用边界：方法基础重要；空间相关噪声和孤立病灶可能被错误去除

Evidence Boundary: Theoretical cornerstone of blind-spot denoising; fails when noise is spatially correlated (e.g., FBP CT streaks) and can erase isolated 1-pixel micro-structures.

Noise2Void

Noise2Void 通过输入操纵构造 blind spot，只从单张 noisy 图像回归其被隐藏中心，而非需要成对噪声或 clean target。

Implements practical single-image blind-spot denoising by randomly masking center pixels via neighborhood replacement so a standard U-Net predicts held-out pixels.

INPUT DOMAIN // 输入域 一张噪声图像；训练时随机选取中心像素并用邻域值替换 Single noisy image (with random center pixels replaced by neighboring values during training)
OUTPUT TARGET // 输出目标 每个像素的条件期望估计形成的去噪图像 Denoised image estimate x̂ from a single forward pass
INSPECT ORIGINAL FIGURE (Figures 2 and 3 · PDF pp.4 and 5)

医学适配：用于显微、低剂量和无法重复采集的医学图像去噪

Medical Translation: Widely used in biomedical microscopy, OCT speckle reduction, and single-acquisition low-dose imaging.

适用边界：自监督去噪经典方法；结构化噪声和相关噪声会违反假设

Evidence Boundary: Classic self-supervised denoiser; structured/correlated noise violates pixel-wise independence and gets preserved as signal.

SPEC 114 / 137 / 2016 / NeurIPS / 对称卷积—反卷积深层图像恢复网络symmetric_conv_deconv_residual_autoencoder
FAMILY 12 · 去噪与图像恢复：残差、盲点与长程建模的假设边界Denoising & Restoration

RED-Net

相较普通 autoencoder，RED-Net 在每个镜像卷积—反卷积层之间建立对称加法 skip，而不只保留少数 U-Net 尺度跳连。

Deep symmetric convolutional–deconvolutional autoencoder connected by layer-by-layer additive residual skip connections at every mirrored depth.

INPUT DOMAIN // 输入域 含噪、压缩或受退化影响的图像 Noisy, blurry, or low-dose degraded image
OUTPUT TARGET // 输出目标 恢复后的高质量图像或残差校正图 Restored clean image recovered via multi-depth additive residual shortcuts

医学适配：启发 CT/MRI 去噪、低剂量恢复和残差式重建网络

Medical Translation: Popularized residual encoder–decoder (RED-CNN) architectures as a primary baseline for low-dose CT image-domain denoising.

适用边界：历史恢复基线；缺显式成像物理与现代注意力建模

Evidence Boundary: Historically influential in low-dose CT denoising; purely image-domain L2 training can still over-smooth low-contrast liver lesions.

SwinIR

Restormer 用 MDTA 在通道维做转置注意力，并以 GDFN 门控深度卷积替代普通 Transformer FFN。

SECTION 13 // Registration & SE(3) DISPLAYING 9 OF 9 SPECIFICATIONS

XIII. 配准与投影几何：可微变换、拓扑约束和 SE(3) 闭环 Deformable Registration & Projective Geometry: Differentiable Warping, Diffeomorphisms & SE(3) Loops

配准网络从 fixed/moving 图像预测变形场或位姿，再通过 spatial transformer 或 differentiable DRR 形成闭环。粗到细、attention、inverse consistency 与连续坐标表示改善捕获范围或可逆性；评价应同时报告 TRE、表面误差、Jacobian<0、尾部失败率和真实标定误差。

Registration networks predict dense displacement fields or rigid SE(3) poses from fixed/moving pairs, closing the loop via spatial transformers or differentiable DRR ray-casting. Multi-scale pyramids, transformers, gradient inverse consistency (GradICON), and implicit coordinate fields expand capture range and invertibility; evaluation must audit TRE, Jacobian folding, surface accuracy, and calibration sensitivity.

SPEC 066 / 137 / 2015 / NeurIPS / differentiable_coordinate_warp
FAMILY 13 · 配准与投影几何：可微变换、拓扑约束和 SE(3) 闭环Registration & SE(3)

Spatial Transformer Network

定位网络预测变换参数，grid generator 与可微 sampler 将任务梯度传回几何坐标。

Predicts geometric transformation parameters θ via a localization network, generates a transformed sampling grid, and warps feature maps via a differentiable sampler.

INPUT DOMAIN // 输入域 输入特征图/图像 U Input image or feature map U
OUTPUT TARGET // 输出目标 按学习变换重采样后的 V Spatially warped feature map V resampled over learned coordinates T_θ(G)
INSPECT ORIGINAL FIGURE (Figure 2 · PDF p.3)

医学适配：成为 VoxelMorph、可微配准和 2D/3D warping 的算子基础

Medical Translation: Provides the foundational differentiable warping operator (`grid_sample`) underlying VoxelMorph and all modern learned medical registration.

适用边界：基础设施；本身不保证变换平滑、可逆或物理合理

Evidence Boundary: Essential differentiable geometry primitive; requires explicit regularization when generalized from low-DOF affine to dense displacement fields.

VoxelMorph

3D U-Net 一次前向预测 dense displacement，并用可微 warping、图像相似度和平滑项无监督训练。

Amortizes pairwise 3D deformable registration into a single U-Net forward pass predicting a dense displacement field u trained unsupervised via image similarity and diffusion smoothness.

INPUT DOMAIN // 输入域 移动图像 m 与固定图像 f Pair of 3D moving volume m and fixed volume f
OUTPUT TARGET // 输出目标 稠密形变 phi 及配准图像 m∘phi Dense 3D deformation field φ = Id + u (or velocity field integrated via scaling-and-squaring) and warped volume m ∘ φ

医学适配：成为 CT/MRI 快速配准最常用的学习式基线

Medical Translation: Foundational fast learning-based baseline for brain MRI, chest CT inspiration–expiration, and longitudinal registration.

适用边界：基础设施级 baseline；跨域、相似度选择和 folding 仍是问题

SPEC 068 / 137 / 2023 / CVPR / bidirectional_gradient_inverse_consistent_registration
FAMILY 13 · 配准与投影几何：可微变换、拓扑约束和 SE(3) 闭环Registration & SE(3)

GradICON

通过双向预测与复合映射 Jacobian 的 gradient inverse-consistency 正则获得近似微分同胚。

Enforces diffeomorphic regularity without tuning sensitive multi-scale smoothness weights by penalizing the Frobenius norm of the composed forward–backward Jacobian deviation from identity.

INPUT DOMAIN // 输入域 图像 A 与图像 B Ordered pairs (I^A, I^B) and (I^B, I^A) fed symmetrically to a registration network
OUTPUT TARGET // 输出目标 近似互逆、规则的双向配准映射 Phi_AB 与 Phi_BA Approximately diffeomorphic, inverse-consistent forward map Φ^AB and backward map Φ^BA
INSPECT ORIGINAL FIGURE (Figure 2 · PDF p.5)

医学适配：在多数据集统一 protocol 上提供强通用配准基线

Medical Translation: Provides a highly regular, topology-preserving 3D registration baseline across brain MRI, lung CT, and abdominal scans.

适用边界：比单纯换 encoder 更具长期价值；仍需病理保持和极端域移位验证

Evidence Boundary: Superior theoretical and empirical regularity over raw smoothness penalties; space-occupying tumors without topological correspondence still require special handling.

SECTION 14 // 2D-to-3D & Neural Fields DISPLAYING 8 OF 8 SPECIFICATIONS

XIV. 2D→3D 与神经场：表示、投影一致性和不可辨识性 2D-to-3D Lifting & Neural Fields: Coordinate Representations, Reprojection Consistency & Non-Identifiability

单视图 2D→3D 本质上不可辨识，网络提供的是解剖先验。Voxel、mesh、implicit field 或 Gaussian 表示必须重新投影回观测，并给出多假设或不确定性。NeRF 与 3DGS 用于 X-ray 等医学模态时，需要改写为衰减积分或其他模态特定 forward model。

Single-view 2D-to-3D reconstruction is mathematically ill-posed; networks supply learned anatomical priors rather than hidden CT measurements. Voxel, mesh, implicit neural representation (INR), or 3D Gaussian Splatting representations must enforce physical reprojection consistency and quantify uncertainty, rewriting RGB alpha compositing into Beer–Lambert X-ray attenuation integrals.

SECTION 15 // Graph & Mesh Networks DISPLAYING 6 OF 6 SPECIFICATIONS

XV. 图神经网络：节点、边与医学拓扑 Graph Neural Networks & Anatomical Meshes: Relational Message Passing & Topological Constraints

GNN 通过邻居消息聚合更新节点状态。血管树、器官 mesh、连接组、细胞图和真实患者事件关系具有天然医学边；任意 kNN patch/patient 图可能编码混杂或数据泄漏，因此需要 graph-free baseline、随机边、替代边消融和真正的 inductive patient split。

GNNs iteratively update node states by aggregating neighborhood messages. Vascular trees, airway branches, cortical surface meshes, connectomes, and spatial cell graphs possess intrinsic physical edges; conversely, heuristic k-NN patient or patch graphs risk encoding batch confounders or transductive leakage, demanding strict graph-free and randomized-edge ablations.

SPEC 075 / 137 / 2017 / ICLR / normalized_graph_convolution
FAMILY 15 · 图神经网络：当边、拓扑和关系本身就是医学信息Graph & Mesh Networks

GCN

以加自环的对称归一化邻接执行共享线性变换后的固定权重邻居聚合。

First-order spectral graph convolution approximation that aggregates 1-hop neighbor features weighted by the symmetrically normalized adjacency matrix with self-loops.

INPUT DOMAIN // 输入域 图 G=(V,E)、节点特征 X 与邻接矩阵 A Graph G=(V,E) with node feature matrix X ∈ R^{N×C} and adjacency matrix A
OUTPUT TARGET // 输出目标 节点级或图级预测 Updated node embeddings H^{(L)} for node classification, link prediction, or pooled graph classification

适用边界：GNN 基础；深层 over-smoothing 与构图泄漏需警惕

Evidence Boundary: Core GNN baseline; stacking many GCN layers causes over-smoothing, and transductive patient-similarity graphs risk severe cohort leakage.

医学适配：用于心脏、肝脏等器官可解释表面重建

Medical Translation: Produces smooth, genus-zero topological meshes for liver, hippocampus, synaptic junctions, and cardiac chambers.

适用边界：医学 mesh 深度学习代表；固定拓扑难处理孔洞和复杂拓扑变化

Evidence Boundary: Strong explicit 3D surface baseline; fixed sphere topology cannot model organs with holes or variable branching without template modification.

SPEC 135 / 137 / 2022 / CVPR / 3D MRI 体特征与图卷积联合的多皮层表面形变coupled_multi_surface_cortical_gcn
FAMILY 15 · 图神经网络：当边、拓扑和关系本身就是医学信息Graph & Mesh Networks

Vox2Cortex

Vox2Cortex 将 3D U-Net 特征在顶点处采样，并以 GCN 同时形变四个互相关联的皮层表面。

Jointly deforms four topologically coupled brain cortical hemisphere templates (left/right white and pial surfaces) in seconds using 3D U-Net voxel features and Residual GCNs.

INPUT DOMAIN // 输入域 3D T1-weighted brain MRI 与四个初始皮层模板表面 3D T1-weighted brain MRI + 4 initialized template meshes (~168,000 total vertices)
OUTPUT TARGET // 输出目标 左右半球 white 与 pial 四个显式 cortical meshes 4 high-resolution, topologically genus-zero cortical meshes (LH/RH white matter and pial surfaces)
INSPECT ORIGINAL FIGURE (Figure 3 · PDF p.4)

医学适配：用于脑 MRI white/pial cortical surface extraction

Medical Translation: High-speed neuroimaging baseline for cortical thickness analysis, Alzheimer's atrophy tracking, and large biobank processing.

适用边界：显式神经解剖表面强基线；异常 anatomy 与跨扫描协议仍具挑战

Evidence Boundary: Domain-specialized explicit surface landmark; severe brain tumors or strokes that disrupt normal cortical topology remain challenging.

SECTION 16 // Temporal Physiological AI DISPLAYING 6 OF 6 SPECIFICATIONS

XVI. 生理时序模型：门控、膨胀卷积、长状态与领域预训练 Physiological Time-Series & Waveform AI: Gated Recurrence, Dilated Convolutions & Biosignal Foundation Models

时序架构受采样率、导联或电极身份、事件边界、实时延迟和患者级聚合约束。LSTM/GRU 用门控保留状态，TCN 用因果膨胀卷积建立可计算感受野，Transformer/SSM 处理长依赖，foundation-style 模型利用大规模无标签信号。ECG 导联是不同电场投影，不能等同普通 channel dropout。

Biosignal architectures are governed by sampling frequency, physical lead/electrode geometry, event boundaries, streaming latency, and patient-level aggregation. LSTMs/GRUs maintain gated memory, TCNs build deterministic causal dilated receptive fields, Transformers/SSMs capture long-range dependencies, and foundation models (HeartBEiT, LaBraM, ECGFounder) pretrain across millions of multi-lead recordings.

SPEC 077 / 137 / 1997 / Neural Computation / gated_recurrent_memory
FAMILY 16 · 生理时序模型：门控、膨胀卷积、长状态与领域预训练Temporal Physiological AI

LSTM

带门控的加性 cell memory 与 recurrent hidden state 分离，使长期信息可选择性保留和读出。

Separates an additive linear cell memory state c_t (governed by forget and input gates) from the non-linear recurrent hidden state h_t to preserve long-term temporal gradients.

INPUT DOMAIN // 输入域 时间序列 x_1...x_T Sequential physiological waveform or longitudinal clinical time series x_1 … x_T
OUTPUT TARGET // 输出目标 逐时刻隐藏状态或序列级预测 Step-wise hidden states h_t or sequence-level diagnostic prediction
INSPECT ORIGINAL FIGURE (Figure 1 · PDF p.7)

医学适配：长期用于小中型 ECG、EEG、EMG 与纵向临床序列

Medical Translation: Long-standing workhorse for 12-lead ECG arrhythmia classification, ICU vitals early-warning scores, and irregular EHR trajectories.

适用边界：仍是低数据序列基线；串行训练慢且长窗口扩展有限

Evidence Boundary: Reliable low-data sequential baseline; sequential step-by-step recurrence prevents parallel training across ultra-long multi-thousand-sample waveforms.

详细正文将在阅读时载入。The full model text loads as you read.

SPEC 078 / 137 / 2018 / arXiv preprint / causal_dilated_temporal_convolution
FAMILY 16 · 生理时序模型：门控、膨胀卷积、长状态与领域预训练Temporal Physiological AI

Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN)

以因果、指数扩张的 1D 卷积残差块并行覆盖长历史，而不使用循环状态。

Stacks 1D causal convolutions with exponentially increasing dilation factors d = 2^l inside residual blocks to cover long historical receptive fields in parallel.

INPUT DOMAIN // 输入域 长度 T 的多通道时间序列 X Multi-channel continuous physiological time series X ∈ R^{C×T}
OUTPUT TARGET // 输出目标 逐时刻或序列级预测 Causal step-wise sequence predictions or pooled episode classification
INSPECT ORIGINAL FIGURE (Figure 1 · PDF p.4)

医学适配：成为 ECG/EEG 等生理信号强、便宜、稳定的 baseline

Medical Translation: Highly competitive, fast, and stable baseline for continuous ECG, EEG seizure detection, PPG, and EMG envelope decoding.

适用边界：长期实用；感受野由 dilation/depth 固定且全局自适应关系有限

Evidence Boundary: Practical first-line waveform baseline; receptive field is fixed by network depth/dilation and weights remain static across inputs.

详细正文将在阅读时载入。The full model text loads as you read.

SPEC 079 / 137 / 2023 / npj Digital Medicine / ecg_image_masked_pretraining_transformer
FAMILY 16 · 生理时序模型：门控、膨胀卷积、长状态与领域预训练Temporal Physiological AI

HeartBEiT

将标准版式 ECG 渲染为图像，以 BEiT 式离散 masked-patch prediction 预训练专用 ViT。

Renders standard 12-lead ECG waveforms as 2D layout images and pretrains a Vision Transformer via BEiT-style discrete masked patch token prediction on 8.5 million ECGs.

INPUT DOMAIN // 输入域 按标准版式渲染的 12 导联 ECG 图像 Standardized 2D image rendering of a 12-lead clinical electrocardiogram
OUTPUT TARGET // 输出目标 ECG 诊断分类概率或迁移表征 Pretrained ECG ViT representation for low-label arrhythmia, LVEF, and STEMI classification
INSPECT ORIGINAL FIGURE (Figure 1 · PDF p.2)

医学适配：提高 ECG 少标签迁移和外部分类表现

Medical Translation: Improves label-efficient transfer for reduced LVEF screening, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, and myocardial infarction detection.

适用边界：证明领域预训练价值；渲染、截断和缩放可能损失精确采样、幅值及采集元数据，并依赖固定版式

Evidence Boundary: Demonstrates the power of scale in ECG SSL; rasterizing 1D voltage time series into 2D pixels discards microvolt resolution and ties the model to a fixed plot layout.

详细正文将在阅读时载入。The full model text loads as you read.

SPEC 080 / 137 / 2024 / ICLR / eeg_masked_neural_token_transformer
FAMILY 16 · 生理时序模型：门控、膨胀卷积、长状态与领域预训练Temporal Physiological AI

LaBraM

以 VQ neural tokenizer 提供离散 EEG patch 目标，再用跨通道/时间 Transformer 做 masked code prediction。

Trains a vector-quantized (VQ) neural spectrum tokenizer to predict Fourier amplitude/phase spectra of EEG patches, then pretrains a cross-channel Transformer via masked code prediction.

INPUT DOMAIN // 输入域 多通道连续 EEG 片段及通道身份 Multi-channel continuous EEG recordings with arbitrary montage channel counts and recording lengths
OUTPUT TARGET // 输出目标 通用 EEG 表征与下游分类/检测输出 Universal EEG representation transferable across seizure detection, sleep staging, emotion, and motor BCI
INSPECT ORIGINAL FIGURE (Figure 1 · PDF p.3)

医学适配：支持 EEG 分类、检测和 BCI 的迁移与少样本学习

Medical Translation: Canonical foundation model for cross-montage EEG abnormality classification, event detection, and brain–computer interfaces.

适用边界：原论文在四类下游任务报告优势；跨设备、跨人群和独立临床验证仍不足

Evidence Boundary: Significant methodological leap for heterogeneous neurophysiology; clinical cross-hospital sensitivity and false-alarm calibration require ongoing validation.

SPEC 136 / 137 / 2014 / EMNLP / reset/update 双门控的循环状态更新dual_gate_recurrent_unit
FAMILY 16 · 生理时序模型：门控、膨胀卷积、长状态与领域预训练Temporal Physiological AI

GRU

GRU 用 reset/update 两门和单一隐藏状态完成记忆更新，结构比 LSTM 更简洁。

Simplifies gated recurrence by merging cell and hidden states into a single vector h_t interpolated via an update gate z_t and a reset gate r_t.

INPUT DOMAIN // 输入域 时间序列 xt 与上一隐藏状态 ht−1 Sequential physiological or clinical feature vector x_t and previous hidden state h_{t-1}
OUTPUT TARGET // 输出目标 当前隐藏状态 ht、全序列表示或逐时刻预测 Updated hidden state h_t or sequence prediction
INSPECT ORIGINAL FIGURE (Figures 1 and 2 · PDF pp.2–3)

医学适配：常用于 ECG、EEG、生命体征和纵向临床序列的小数据基线

Medical Translation: Widely used in compact wearable biosignal monitors, GRU-D missing-value clinical EHR time series, and edge medical devices.

适用边界：仍是轻量时序基线；串行计算和超长依赖能力弱于现代并行模型

Evidence Boundary: Lightweight recurrent baseline; like LSTM, remains bottlenecked by sequential step-by-step training on ultra-long sequences.

详细正文将在阅读时载入。The full model text loads as you read.

SPEC 137 / 137 / 2025 / NEJM AI / 大规模 150 标签监督预训练的 RegNet-1D 多导联 ECG encoderclinical_scale_1d_regnet_ecg_foundation
FAMILY 16 · 生理时序模型：门控、膨胀卷积、长状态与领域预训练Temporal Physiological AI

ECGFounder

ECGFounder 是 RegNet/Net1D 风格的 1D CNN foundation model，以超过千万波形和 150 类监督规模为核心，不应误写为通用 Transformer SSL。

1D RegNet-style residual CNN with Squeeze-and-Excitation blocks pretrained via multi-label clinical supervision across >10 million 12-lead ECGs and 150 diagnostic categories.

INPUT DOMAIN // 输入域 标准化的 12 导联或适配后的任意单导联 ECG 波形 Raw multi-lead (12-lead) or lead-masked single-lead 1D ECG voltage waveform tensor
OUTPUT TARGET // 输出目标 150 类诊断概率、通用 ECG embedding 与下游微调预测 150-class diagnostic probability vector and general-purpose 1D ECG representation
INSPECT ORIGINAL FIGURE (Figure 1 · PDF p.10)

医学适配：用于心律失常、结构性心脏病和风险预测等 ECG 任务

Medical Translation: High-performing open-weight ECG foundation baseline for arrhythmia diagnosis, structural heart disease screening, and wearable ECG triage.

适用边界：超大规模 ECG FM 代表；设备、群体公平性和前瞻效益仍需验证

Evidence Boundary: Proves that a well-engineered 1D CNN at 10M-sample clinical scale rivals or outperforms complex Transformers; prospective clinical trial validation remains the next frontier.

SECTION 15 // APPLICABILITY BOUNDARIES & CONCLUSIONS
ZH // 中文原著论述

适用边界

  • 新模型的正式发表、作者 benchmark、独立 benchmark、读者研究与前瞻工作流证据不能等同。
  • 参数量、slice/patch/mask 数、FID、SSIM、Dice 或语言流畅度都不足以单独证明临床成熟度。
  • Data consistency 依赖正确的 operator、coil map、geometry、noise model 与 calibration；错误 forward model 仍可能产生低 residual 的错误解。
  • 临床使用必须结合当地设备、人群、监管、工作流和人工回退重新验证。
EN // ENGLISH MONOGRAPH TEXT

Scope Boundaries & Methodological Caveats

  • Peer-reviewed publication, author-reported internal benchmarks, independent external benchmarks, blinded reader studies, and prospective clinical workflow trials represent fundamentally distinct levels of evidence and must never be conflated.
  • Parameter count, pretraining slice/patch/mask volume, FID, SSIM, mean Dice, or linguistic fluency is never sufficient in isolation to establish clinical readiness.
  • Physics-informed data consistency depends on accurate forward operators, coil sensitivity maps, projection geometry, noise models, and scanner calibration; an incorrect forward model can still converge to a low-residual but anatomically erroneous solution.
  • Any real-world clinical deployment requires local re-validation across target scanners, patient demographics, regulatory intended-use boundaries, and human-in-the-loop fallback workflows.
ZH // 中文原著论述

结论

  • 卷积、attention 与 selective SSM 分别编码局部先验、全局动态关系和长序列状态压缩，混合结构通常比单一路线更符合医学数据约束。
  • U-Net 与 nnU-Net 表明，拓扑、空间配置、采样、训练和推理系统共同决定医学性能；单一模块改动很少构成完整范式。
  • SSL、图文对齐、prompt 与 adapter/LoRA 扩展知识复用，但目标函数、数据单位、患者级去重、外部验证和校准决定实际价值。
  • 重建、配准、2D→3D、导航与生成必须显式处理 forward model、geometry、null space 和 uncertainty；视觉真实感不能替代测量真值。
EN // ENGLISH MONOGRAPH TEXT

Core Conclusions

  • Convolutions, self-attention, and selective SSMs respectively encode local spatial priors, content-dependent global interactions, and linear-time state compression; hybrid architectures that combine local convolutional stems with global mixers align best with biomedical data constraints.
  • The enduring success of U-Net and nnU-Net proves that information topology, physical spacing configuration, sampling heuristics, training recipes, and inference post-processing jointly govern clinical segmentation performance; isolated block replacements rarely constitute a new paradigm.
  • Self-supervised learning, vision–language alignment, spatial prompts, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (Adapters/LoRA) dramatically expand knowledge reuse, but pretraining objectives, independent patient units, deduplication, external validation, and probability calibration determine real-world utility.
  • Tomographic reconstruction, deformable/2D-3D registration, neural rendering, and generative modeling must explicitly account for physical forward operators, projection geometry, null-space ambiguity, and predictive uncertainty; visual realism can never substitute for measurement ground truth.

GITHUB PAGES // OPEN WEBSITE DEPLOYMENT GUIDE (开源网站一键发布指南)

STATIC SINGLE-FILE + GITHUB ACTIONS WORKFLOW // ZERO EXTERNAL DEPENDENCIES

本图谱已构建为零外部运行时依赖的标准静态站点（内嵌全部 137 张高清原论文架构图、137 组命名空间隔离的矢量公式与完整中英双语语料），可直接通过 GitHub Pages 托管为永久公开访问的学术网站。

OPTION 01 // ONE-COMMAND TERMINAL PUSH

终端一键推送到 GitHub Pages

解压配套的 biomed-ai-atlas-github-pages.zip 部署包，进入目录后执行：

git init -b main
git add index.html README.md LICENSE .nojekyll .github/
git commit -m "feat: publish bilingual 137 Biomedical AI Architecture Atlas (2012-2026)"
git remote add origin https://github.com/xiaoyangaizxx-dev/biomed-ai-atlas.git
git push -u origin main
OPTION 02 // GITHUB WEB UPLOAD (NO CLI NEEDED)

网页端直接拖拽上传启用 Pages

  1. 在 GitHub 新建公开仓库（例如 biomed-ai-atlas，勾选 Public）。
  2. 点击 Add file → Upload files，将部署包内的 index.html、README.md、.nojekyll 拖入并点击 Commit changes（单文件约 18 MB，低于 GitHub 网页上传 25 MB 上限）。
  3. 进入仓库 Settings → Pages，在 Build and deployment 下选择 Deploy from a branch → main / /(root)，保存后 60 秒即可通过 https://xiaoyangaizxx-dev.github.io/biomed-ai-atlas/ 全球公开访问。
